notes: Editable starting taxonomy. Each proposition is a directional policy statement; stance is support/oppose relative to it. Changing a topic's text re-runs only that topic's stance analysis.

topics.label: Property tax increase
topics.proposition: The city should raise property taxes to fund its budget.
topics.description: Property tax levy, tax hikes, revenue to close the budget deficit, homeowner tax burden.

topics.label: New taxes and fees
topics.proposition: The city should adopt new taxes or fees (beyond property tax) to raise revenue.
topics.description: Head tax, employer tax, amusement tax, grocery tax, cloud tax, fines and fees, progressive revenue.

topics.label: Spending cuts and efficiencies
topics.proposition: The city should cut spending or headcount to balance its budget.
topics.description: Austerity, layoffs, vacant positions, department cuts, efficiencies, structural deficit, borrowing.

topics.label: Police funding and staffing
topics.proposition: The city should increase funding or staffing for the Chicago Police Department.
topics.description: CPD budget, officer hiring, overtime, police districts, sworn officers, public safety spending.

topics.label: Non-police crisis response and violence prevention
topics.proposition: The city should expand non-police crisis response and community violence prevention programs.
topics.description: Mental health responders, community violence intervention, peacekeepers, treatment not trauma, ShotSpotter alternatives.

topics.label: Police oversight and accountability
topics.proposition: The city should strengthen civilian oversight and accountability of police.
topics.description: COPA, consent decree, misconduct settlements, community commission for public safety and accountability.

topics.label: Affordable housing
topics.proposition: The city should expand affordable housing requirements or funding.
topics.description: Affordable requirements ordinance, housing bonds, rent burden, displacement, homelessness, CHA.

topics.label: Tenant protections
topics.proposition: The city should strengthen protections for renters.
topics.description: Evictions, just cause, landlord regulation, rent stabilization, tenant rights, right to counsel.

topics.label: TIF and development incentives
topics.proposition: The city should use TIF districts or tax incentives to subsidize private development.
topics.description: Tax increment financing, TIF surplus, subsidies, megadevelopments, stadium financing, corporate incentives.

topics.label: Small business deregulation and support
topics.proposition: The city should loosen licensing and regulatory requirements on local businesses.
topics.description: Business licenses, permits, red tape, small business grants, outdoor dining, consumer protection rules.

topics.label: Transit and safe streets investment
topics.proposition: The city should increase investment in public transit, biking, and pedestrian safety.
topics.description: CTA service, buses, bike lanes, traffic calming, speed cameras, Vision Zero, transit fiscal cliff.

topics.label: Aldermanic prerogative
topics.proposition: Alderpersons should retain control over zoning, permits, and land use decisions in their wards.
topics.description: Aldermanic privilege, ward zoning control, upzoning, by-right development, permit approvals.

topics.label: Ethics and transparency
topics.proposition: The city should strengthen ethics rules, oversight, and transparency.
topics.description: Inspector general, board of ethics, lobbying, conflicts of interest, open records, campaign finance.

topics.label: Migrant shelter and services
topics.proposition: The city should spend city funds on shelter and services for new arrivals and migrants.
topics.description: Asylum seekers, new arrivals, shelters, welcoming city ordinance, sanctuary city, federal immigration enforcement.

topics.label: Public health and mental health services
topics.proposition: The city should expand public health and mental health services.
topics.description: Mental health clinics, department of public health, overdose prevention, behavioral health, hospitals.

topics.label: Chicago Public Schools funding
topics.proposition: The city should increase financial support or borrowing for Chicago Public Schools.
topics.description: CPS budget, school board, pension payments, teacher contracts, school closures, education funding.

topics.label: Climate and environmental regulation
topics.proposition: The city should adopt stronger climate and environmental protections.
topics.description: Clean energy, building decarbonization, pollution, environmental justice, lead service lines, water.

topics.label: Wages and worker protections
topics.proposition: The city should raise wages or strengthen worker protections.
topics.description: Minimum wage, tipped wage, paid leave, unions, collective bargaining, city workforce contracts.
